name: Connors RSI(2) pullback with SMA200 trend and SMA5 exit (StockCharts verification)
author: Larry Connors (via StockCharts ChartSchool)
license: StockCharts ChartSchool educational text; paraphrased, not copied
instruments_timeframes: Daily stocks/index ETFs in source (S&P 500, DIA, AAPL examples); crypto port is untested by source.
entry_long: Close > SMA(200) and RSI(2) < 10 (Connors tested 0-10 thresholds; RSI(2) < 5 gave higher subsequent returns). Enter either just before the close or at next open.
entry_short: Close < SMA(200) and RSI(2) > 90 (stricter: > 95). Enter before close or next open.
exit: Exit long when close moves above SMA(5).
stop_loss: None in Connors rule set (his tests found stops hurt on stocks/indices); StockCharts suggests optionally a trailing stop or Parabolic SAR.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: SMA(200) trend side; threshold choice 10 vs 5 (shorts 90 vs 95).
implementation_notes: Same family as existing connors-rsi2-trend-pullback (QuantConnect-derived); this record verifies the thresholds against the StockCharts statement of the rule set. Short side symmetric. Entry timing: close vs open are both allowed by source.
